caption: The drawing depicts a metal object resembling a horseshoe, primarily brownish-gray in color with a slightly textured, metallic appearance. At the top arch of the horseshoe, there is an inscription that reads “GOOD LUCK.” The object is open in the center, containing a decorative geometric design, including two interlocking five-pointed stars, created by intersecting lines in the middle. Surrounding the stars and filling the interior of the horseshoe is an inscription in capital letters that reads, “WHOSE HOUSE THIS IS AND ONE'S.” The edges of the horseshoe have small rectangular cutouts spaced evenly apart, consistent with traditional horseshoe design. The bottom part of the object transitions into a handle-like extension with a teardrop-shaped loop and three small spherical knobs at its end. The entire drawing is rendered against a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature, "SYD A. ROBERTS," appears at the lower right.
title: Trivet
